timing_method: Ordinary strict public evolving steps, no profiler. Step timers include public admission, numerical stages and validation. Result/snapshot hashing, setup, request construction, diagnostics, progress output and final snapshot are outside step timers. Simulation wall includes loop overhead; work wall includes setup and snapshot but excludes imports and final report writing.
process_wall_method: /usr/bin/time -f 'process_wall_seconds=%e'; includes interpreter startup and report writing
